class.name: PuertsWebBackend
class.description: Pass an instance to [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to select Browser JavaScript. Scripts share the browser's [code]globalThis[/code] and can access browser APIs such as the DOM. Use [code]ClassDB.instantiate("PuertsWebBackend")[/code] in scripts that must parse in the desktop editor, where this Web-only class is unavailable. [b]Note:[/b] Only one environment can be created. It remains alive until page unload; disposal and reinitialization are unsupported.

method.name: _puerts_get_functions_ptr
method.description: Internal interface used by [method PuertsEnvironment.initialize] to obtain the backend function table.
